pr_title: Expose selectable property of ItemList's Item and set default to true
pr_body:
Fix #56570

### Issue description

Items added to ``ItemList`` in editor are not selectable by default whereas ``add_item()`` function adds a selectable item.

### Fix proposal
- Set ``selectable`` property default to ``true``, so even if item is not added via ``add_item()`` it will be selectable by default
- Expose this property in editor inspector

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3649998/148620740-61b7c8dc-b56b-4e14-89cb-2bc75d230c7a.png)

comments:
Seems added items are not selectable by default in 4.0.
```GDScript
func _ready():
    for i in range($ItemList.item_count):
        $ItemList.set_item_selectable(i, true)
```
![itemlist](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12966814/148527562-9ab876be-cad4-4e32-a73e-02b3722ba5c2.gif)

This is caused by #54342. Item's `selectable` is false by default, but `add_item()` method has selectable as true. But the new editor seems to not use `add_item()`, hence the internal default is used.

We should make Item's `selectable` true by default and expose this property in the editor.

review_comments:
Shouldn't this be 
```suggestion
		pi.usage &= ~(!is_item_selectable(i) ? PROPERTY_USAGE_STORAGE : 0);
```
Like for `disabled`?

IIUC this will store the value when `selectable` is enabled (default) and not when disabled. It should be the other way around (store non-default).
Nevermind I think I misread, this is probably good as is. It makes sense that's it's the opposite logic to `disabled` here.

In my first try I've done the same as disabled. But it was not working : By default items were selectable but the switch checkbox didn't have any effects at first uncheck. (need to uncheck, check and uncheck).

I though it was because selectable is true by default whereas disabled is false by default so the logic of this line need to be inverted.

After changing this line (removing the ``!``), all was working as expected.
